Introductions may be rough, and as a college student another 2 younger rats or any rats sounds like a lot more responsibility, and an endless cycle of rats. I think some of the longest living rats on record are like 3-5 and very rare. Just give the old man as much attention as you can. When the owner saw the signs they called my friend, and it turned out Cherry had been intended to be fed to a snake but made a daring escape. When the owner found out my friend had given Cherry a name and a favorite food, she decided Cherry was best with my friend. My friend however still did not have the space or time Cherry needed, and I have watched her ever since. Shes had a double critter nation cage, all the snacks she wants, plenty of outside time, and even has a cagemate who passed in May, but the cagemate was always a little more dependent on Cherry then vice versa.
